facts.claim: Mr. Frank Levien was questioned about how a settlement in the shares of the Hyderabad Deccan Company was obtained.
facts.quote: To connnence with, this gentleman was questioned as to the peculiar method in which a settlement in the shares of the Deccan Company was obtained.

facts.claim: The Parliamentary Committee was appointed to investigate the formation and promotion of the Hyderabad Deccan Mining Company.
facts.quote: The Parliamentary Committee appointed to inquire into the circumstances attending the formation and promotion of the Hyderabad Deccan Mining Company, Limited, the circumstances under which the concession was obtained, and the subsequent operations by parties interested on the London Stock Exchange, met at the House of Commons yesterday.
